notes:
Venture 0.17 — one app

The controller is now a single application. Venture is the home screen;
Venture Home and Cyan are no longer installed alongside it.

• New home screen — Fly, Plan, Missions, Config — each opening straight to
  the thing, with no second menu in between. Review has a place but is not
  built yet.
• Wi-Fi can be set up on the controller. Config > Wi-Fi turns the radio on,
  lists what is in range and joins a network. The map downloads its imagery
  over that connection; with no network an area you have not visited before
  draws as an empty grid.
• The new-mission chooser, compass calibration and every text field are now
  full screens, and each one has a visible way back. The keyboard gained the
  symbols needed to type a Wi-Fi password.
• Fly and Compass stay unavailable until the aircraft is connected, and say
  why rather than opening onto nothing.

Migration: this updates Venture only. A controller provisioned before this
release still carries Venture Home and Cyan and still boots to Venture Home,
so it will show that launcher with Venture's own home screen behind it. Such
a unit must be re-provisioned to become the single-app kiosk: device
ownership cannot be moved between packages on Android 7, so the previous
owner has to be cleared first. See tools/provision.
